segment.label: the active segment's folder, which the map lies on: its ink detection records find the reverse-depth twin, and its name and catalog ids feed the target rule (rowscore itself reads only the maps)

voxel_um.help: map pixel size in micrometers (auto: from the volume)

vc3d.label: Text-row triage score (rowscore) of the selected ink map

facts.title: rowscore
facts.tagline: text-row periodicity triage score for ink maps
facts.success: Exit code 0 and a non-null, non-NaN `forward.score`.
facts.not_a_pass: A forward score with no reverse; a forward score that is not well above the reverse; any score on a patch under a few cm2; a result with `largest_piece` false; a high score read as text; scores from a segment the model trained on read as generalization.
facts.never: Call a row score a reading, or say rows or letters were found; use it as a pass bar or as the only reason to drop a map from visual review; compare a `--fast-resize` score with a dense one to two decimals.
